project.title: Alien Abductee Charles Hickson on To Tell The Truth
project.description:
The October 1973 incident which has come to be known as the Pascagoula Encounter was an alleged UFO sighting and alien abduction where Charles Hickson and Calvin Parker claimed to be abducted by aliens while fishing near Pascagoula, Mississippi.

Charles Hickson  passed away in 2011 at the age of 81. 

The video to be annotated is uploaded for discussion between those who would share the evidence supporting the conclusion that this report is a hoax as well as from those who believe it to be genuine.

The project is to annotate the people's words and actions to find the relation between performing lie and not lying.
